level_rationale: Passing hard dry stools yesterday and today with mild lower belly bloating during a 4-day work trip in a 46-year-old adult is uncomplicated short-term travel stool hardening appropriate for over-the-counter laxative or stool-softener medicine, whereas passing stools streaked with dark red blood yesterday and today with mild lower belly bloating in a 46-year-old adult is a colorectal bleeding alarm sign where over-the-counter self-treatment is inappropriate and an outpatient doctor evaluation is required.
